description:
Get the published commercial terms for one Fortitude21 product: pricing type, currency, minimum order, quantity bands with any approved indicative unit price, validity, Incoterms and lead time.
Use when: the user asks about price, minimum order or lead time for a known product. Instead: create_quote_request for an actual quotation; search_products with pricing_type to find products by pricing model.
Inputs: sku is read as in get_product_details. Without quantity it returns every band. With quantity it also returns the band that covers it; below the minimum order no unit price is given and assumed says so; a quantity in the top band returns a quotation band rather than a price. A quantity under 1 returns ok:false.
Behaviour: any price is indicative, never a quotation: binding is always false, and prices exclude freight, duty and taxes. Products priced on request return no number. An unknown sku returns ok:false with example ids.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

quantity.description: Optional units to price, e.g. 500. Returns the band that covers it in band and for_quantity

sku.description: An F21 part number or product slug, from search_products

name: get_product_pricing

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

pricing.description: sku, pricing_type, currency, minimum_order_quantity, bands, for_quantity, band, starting_from, price_valid_until, incoterms, lead_time_days, sample, binding (always false), disclaimer and quote_url

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Get Fortitude21 indicative pricing
